name: task3_v5_score_topk_weighted_structure_mixtures
question: Does a frozen coarse-grid, score-weighted mixture of the v5 fused-score top-k glyph bank images improve official OCF over the v5 single-glyph unique-assignment baseline on the fixed public Task3 heldout partition?
hypothesis_status: The weighted pixel mean is a falsifiable structured-combination hypothesis. It is not claimed to be a strict Bayesian posterior, an expected-OCF optimum, or a probabilistically calibrated reconstruction.

relation_to_prior_work.increment: This experiment uses the frozen v5 three-branch scores and production Task3 checkpoints, selects independent per-row top-k candidates without forcing the assigned glyph, performs no second Hungarian assignment, and verifies consistency with the production predict_task path. The earlier experiment used two branches, older checkpoints, and assignment-aware candidates; this is not an identical replication.

data_scope.model_training_scope: Only the split train_trials were used by the already-frozen checkpoints; this experiment performs no model fitting.
data_scope.prediction_scope: Only split validation_trials are scored. Hidden test blocks, hidden test targets, and Kaggle submission artifacts are never read or written.
data_scope.split_metadata_check: Every block must have disjoint train_trials and validation_trials.
data_scope.picture_partition: numpy.random.default_rng(123).permutation(2748); sorted first 256 IDs are tune and sorted IDs 256:768 are heldout.

historical_reuse.disclosure: These heldout picture IDs were used in earlier experiments and informed candidate design. No parameter or candidate selection is permitted on heldout in this experiment; results are a historically reused public evaluation, not pristine independent confirmation.

production_reproduction.score_formula: (row_zscore(MLP logits) + row_zscore(encoding MSE response scores) + row_zscore(softmax DCT continuous cosine similarity)) / 3
production_reproduction.row_zscore: Per-row mean subtraction and division by max(per-row population standard deviation, 1e-6).
production_reproduction.continuous_branch: src.retrieval.softmax_dct_similarity with T=1 over MLP logits and the DCT16 coefficient bank centered across all 2748 images.
production_reproduction.capture_method: Monkeypatch only src.final.unique_assignment and src.final.softmax_dct_similarity in the experiment process to capture the exact per-block continuous scores, fused scores, and assignments while executing the unmodified production predict_task body.
required_assertions: Task3 config has assignment=true, prototype_continuous enabled with temperature=1, no seeds other than 42, and no enabled Task3 reranker.
src.final.predict_task returns reranker=null; any invocation of src.final.apply_listwise_reranker fails the run.
The independently reconstructed three-branch fused scores match every captured fused score with rtol=1e-5 and atol=1e-6.
The independently computed full-block Hungarian assignment matches every captured production assignment exactly.
Stable descending top-16 indices match predict_task(candidate_top_n=16) candidate_indices exactly for every row.
Production top1 means the pre-assignment fused-score argmax; its identity accuracy is reported separately from the assigned identity accuracy.

baseline.name: v5_full_block_unique_assignment
baseline.method: Apply scipy linear_sum_assignment(maximize=True), through src.retrieval.unique_assignment, independently to each complete 2748-row validation block using the v5 fused scores, then select the corresponding single bank glyph per row.
baseline.subset_rule: Score tune and heldout only after full-block assignment; never re-run assignment on a picture subset.
baseline.identity_metrics: Report both pre-assignment fused-score top1 accuracy and post-assignment identity accuracy on tune and heldout.

candidate_family.candidate_order: For each row independently, stable descending argsort of the full 2748-column v5 fused scores; take the first k IDs. Do not force or exclude the Hungarian-assigned ID.
candidate_family.grid_order_and_tie_break: Nested ascending order: k, then temperature, then threshold. The first configuration attaining the maximum tune overall OCF wins.
candidate_family.weights: For selected fused scores s, compute softmax((s - max(s))/temperature) within each row's top-k. These weights normalize to one over only the selected candidates.
candidate_family.reconstruction: Weighted pixel-wise mean of the k binary bank images, then output 1 where the mean is greater than or equal to the threshold and 0 otherwise.
candidate_family.assignment: None. Rows are independent and mixed reconstructions may repeat identities or contain no single identity.
candidate_family.label_use: Picture labels are used only for official OCF evaluation and identity diagnostics, never for candidate ranking, mixture weights, thresholds, or reconstruction.
candidate_family.identity_metrics: The common pre-assignment score-top1 accuracy is reported for context. Final mixed-image identity accuracy is null because a mixture has no single predicted glyph ID.

metric_and_aggregation.metric: src.evaluation.score_predictions official OCF with PNG parity, without an additional threshold argument because candidates are already binary.
metric_and_aggregation.reporting_scale: Native score_predictions output (approximately percentage points), with no rescaling.
metric_and_aggregation.overall: Unweighted mean over all rows in the indicated partition.
metric_and_aggregation.per_mouse: Unweighted pooled mean over that mouse's four blocks and all rows in the indicated partition.
metric_and_aggregation.per_group: Unweighted mean within each of the eight mouse/session blocks; also report group macro mean descriptively.
metric_and_aggregation.delta: Locked mixture candidate OCF minus baseline OCF on identical rows.
metric_and_aggregation.additional_outputs: Retain per-row OCF for baseline and the locked candidate on both partitions; retain all 36 candidates' tune per-row OCF so tune summaries are reproducible. Loser candidates are never scored on heldout.

selection_and_advancement.tuning: Evaluate baseline and all 36 candidates on tune. Select exactly one candidate by maximum tune overall OCF with the frozen tie-break. Baseline is not a grid candidate and cannot be selected as the mixture winner.
selection_and_advancement.lock_before_heldout: Write selection.json containing all tune results and the single locked configuration before any candidate heldout scoring.
selection_and_advancement.heldout: Score baseline and only the locked candidate on heldout. Do not alter the grid, selection rule, thresholds, or advancement rule after seeing heldout results.
selection_and_advancement.advance_rule: advance=true if and only if (1) heldout pooled OCF delta is strictly greater than 0 for mice1 AND mice2, and (2) at least 5 of the 8 block groups have strictly positive heldout OCF delta.
selection_and_advancement.failure_rule: If advance=false, stop: no further candidate search, grid expansion, heldout retuning, or follow-up selection within this experiment.

execution.reproducibility: manifest.json records the preregistration and input SHA256 hashes, model artifact hashes, runtime environment, exact command, output hashes, and picture IDs or references to their stored locations.

scope_limits: Create or modify files only under test/44_task3_score_mixtures.
Do not modify src, other experiments, trained checkpoints, Kaggle submissions, or Git history.
This public historical-reuse result does not establish hidden-test generalization or statistical independence.
